svg.title: Account architecture
svg.desc: The hexagon of the account bounded context: the console adapter and the Kafka stream adapter, whose policies receive each TransactionRegistered from the event bus, drive the application through the FailuresSolving and BalanceAdjusting inbound ports, the handlers adjust each AccountBalance, and the repository, troubleshooting and notices adapters implement the outbound ports over PostgreSQL and the console log. The query slice reads PostgreSQL apart from the application, as CQRS prescribes.
